owner_and_capability: Delivery owns notification dispatch, localized copy and branding. Communication owns application event DTOs and narrow producer ports; Root binds native public Delivery commands. Partial Refs #4074.
affected_tables: Existing notification consent, audience and durable delivery stores through the same router. No SQL, schema, migration or backfill change.
atomic_cutover: Replace eight private notification imports and four locale/branding imports with native Communication application events, exact producer/preferences/error/copy ports, public Delivery commands and Root bindings to the same router. Twelve keys fall151->139; #4074 34->22. Rules844, epoch72, composition1657, Communication compose1514 and total compose34612 do not rise. Existing adapter-to-own-application and application-to-own-public grants suffice. All twelve event fields and seven audience fields survive, including student, school, portal, singular/batch guardian and staff selectors; none widen. Preserve nil/empty maps and slices, absent dependencies, original context, count plus error, consent filters, transactions and AfterCommit. Move canonical generic parent-message/announcement copy once within Delivery into its existing locales application, without changing strings. Canonical dispatch sentinels move to the existing public devices capability; private names retain the same identities. The actual router implements two native commands and delegates to the original methods; no second router. Request-decision fixture still constructs the real producer with its exact one-operation consent port. No new rule, type alias, package classification, exception, graph field or increased budget. One obsolete copy function-length exception disappears. Routes, responses, goldens, IoT, relationship permissions, sessions and wrong-portal rejection stay unchanged. Announcement service file-size budget shrinks1188->1183; single-receipt callback retains count1 even on error without another stored dependency.
